entities.name: Antoni Gałecki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antoni Gałecki was a Polish footballer who played as a defender, spending most of his career with ŁKS Łódź. He also played on the Poland national team during the 1936 Berlin Olympics and Poland's 1938 FIFA World Cup lone match against Brazil.
